situation: A Folio opens with the Stay
given: a Property that does billing (billing_folios Entitlement and finance enabled)
when: a Staff Member checks a Guest in
then: a Folio opens in the check-in's own transaction, open, with no lines and a balance of zero, in the Property's currency read by openFolioWithin from the Property row rather than from the caller (ADR 0015, ADR 0020)
test_name: folios.test.ts: gives a checked-in Guest a Folio in the Property's own currency; gives one in dirhams at a Property that trades in dirhams

situation: A Property that does not bill
given: the Organization lacks the billing_folios Entitlement or the Property has not enabled finance
when: a Staff Member checks a Guest in
then: the check-in succeeds with a Stay and no Folio: openFolioWithin returns null rather than raising, because an unbought billing module must not break the front desk (ADR 0015 Consequences)
test_name: folios.test.ts: checks a Guest in with no Folio where the Property does not do billing

situation: A second Folio for one Stay
given: a Stay already has a Folio
when: anybody opens another on it
then: refused by the unique index on (stay_id, property_id, organization_id): one Folio per Stay, because split folios are blueprint 5.9 and not built (PR #30)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a Stay has at most one Folio: split folios are not built

situation: A currency that is not a code
given: a Folio or a Property
when: its currency is written as anything but three upper-case letters
then: refused by folios_currency_check and properties_currency_check (ISO 4217 shape; PR #30, migration 20260916001200_folios)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a currency is three upper-case letters, not whatever was typed

situation: A Folio opened in a currency its Property does not trade in
given: the runtime role holds insert on folios.currency (IG-04) and no constraint compares it with properties.currency
when: a statement other than openFolioWithin opens a Folio naming another valid code
then: the database accepts it; only openFolioWithin's statement, which copies properties.currency, keeps the two equal. ADR 0015 says a caller must not be able to name a currency, and the module is the only thing that makes that true

given: a Property with open and closed Folios
when: its currency is changed
then: no existing Folio is restated: each keeps the currency it copied when it opened, and only Folios opened afterwards use the new one. Lines carry no currency column at all, so a sum can never mix two (ADR 0015). No test changes a Property's currency or asserts the column's absence

situation: An amount that is not a whole number of minor units
given: a Staff Member holding finance.post_charge on an open Folio
when: they post 10.5 minor units, or more than Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
then: refused with FolioAmountError before anything is written; amounts are signed integer minor units in a bigint column, never a float (ADR 0015)
test_name: folios.test.ts: refuses an amount that is not one

given: an open Folio
when: a line of 0 is posted
then: refused by folio_lines_amount_check (a line that changes no balance is not a posting; migration 20260916001200_folios, PR #30) and by the module first
test_name: folios.test.sql: a line of zero is not a posting

given: an open Folio
when: a charge with a negative amount is posted
then: refused by folio_lines_type_check: a charge is positive and names no line, a reversal is negative and names one (ADR 0015); taking money off is a reversal
test_name: folios.test.sql: a charge is positive: making one negative is a reversal, and must say so

given: an open Folio
when: a charge is posted with a blank description or one over 200 characters
then: refused: folio_lines_description_check requires 1-200 characters after trimming, and the module refuses first with FolioAmountError naming the field (PR #30). Only a blank description is tested, through the module; neither the 200-character limit nor the constraint is
test_name: folios.test.ts: refuses an amount that is not one

situation: An amount typed on the Finance screen
given: an open Folio in a currency with n minor digits
when: a Staff Member types 12,50 or 12.5 or 12.505
then: a comma or a point is the decimal separator; more fraction digits than the currency has is invalid; the exponent comes from Intl for the currency, so JPY has none and KWD three. Exercised by hand in PR #30; toMinorUnits has no automated test

situation: Only a charge or a reversal
given: an open Folio
when: a line of any other type — payment, credit, deposit, refund — is posted
then: refused by folio_lines_type_check; there is no line type waiting for a workflow that is not built (ADR 0015, PR #30)
test_name: folios.test.sql: there is no payment line: recording money is a workflow this slice does not build

situation: The balance is the sum of the lines
given: a Folio with several lines
when: it is read
then: the balance is sum(amount_minor) computed in the statement that selects the lines: not a column, not a view, not a function (ADR 0015); an empty Folio's balance is zero
test_name: folios.test.ts: adds up several charges, and is stored nowhere; folios.test.sql: the balance is the sum of the lines, and is stored nowhere

situation: A charge lands while the detail is being read
given: a Folio open on the Finance screen
when: a charge commits between the summary and the lines
then: folioDetail reads both in one transaction, so the total always matches the rows printed under it (module and README, PR #30); no test interleaves a charge

situation: A reader who can see only some lines
given: a future narrower read policy on folio_lines
when: the balance is shown
then: the sum covers exactly the rows the policy let through, because it is aggregated in the same statement; a security definer total is rejected by ADR 0015. Today the read is reach-based, so no reader sees part of a Folio and nothing tests this

given: an open Folio carrying a charge
when: a Staff Member reverses it with a reason
then: a new reversal line of -original.amount_minor, computed by the database, references the charge; the charge stays exactly as posted and is shown as reversed; the balance follows (ADR 0015)
test_name: folios.test.ts: follows a reversal down, keeping both lines; folios.test.sql: a charge is corrected by reversing it

given: a charge of 125.50
when: a reversal of 0.50 naming it is inserted
then: refused by folio_line_is_postable(): a reversal cancels its line exactly; a partial correction is an adjustment, which is not built (ADR 0015)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a reversal cancels its line exactly: a partial one is an adjustment, which is not built

given: an open Folio
when: a reversal with no reverses_line_id is inserted
then: refused by folio_lines_type_check (ADR 0015: a reversal references the line it corrects)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a reversal must name the line it corrects

given: a charge already reversed
when: it is reversed again
then: refused by the unique index on (reverses_line_id, folio_id); the module reports FolioWriteError and the balance is unchanged (ADR 0015: a line is reversible once)
test_name: folios.test.ts: refuses to reverse the same line twice; folios.test.sql: a line is reversed at most once

given: a reversal line
when: somebody reverses it
then: not possible: reverseLine only selects charges, and a positive line naming another fails folio_lines_type_check (migration comment, PR #30). No test attempts it

situation: A reversal pointing at another Folio's line
given: a line on another Folio, in this Organization or another
when: a reversal on this Folio names it
then: refused: the composite foreign key (reverses_line_id, folio_id) makes a line on another Folio unrepresentable, and another Organization's line is not visible to cancel (PR #30)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a reversal cannot name another Organization's line: it is not there to be cancelled; nor a line on another Folio, even one it can see

situation: A reversal without a real reason
given: a charge on an open Folio
when: it is reversed with an empty, two-character, or over-200-character reason
then: refused with FolioAmountError before anything is written: the reason is both the reversal's description (max 200) and the audit record's reason (min 3), and taking money off must be explained (blueprint 4.4, 7.4)
test_name: folios.test.ts: refuses a reason neither the line nor the record would accept

situation: A reversal whose audit record fails
given: a charge on an open Folio
when: the reversal line is written and the audit record then fails
then: both roll back: the charge is not reversed and no record of a reversal exists (PR #30)
test_name: folios.test.ts: leaves nothing half-done when the second write fails

given: a closed Folio with a charge
when: somebody reverses the charge
then: refused by the same trigger that refuses any line on a closed Folio, and the screen offers no reverse action there. Only a charge on a closed Folio is tested; a reversal there is not

given: a Staff Member without finance.post_charge
when: they reverse a line
then: refused by folio_lines_insert_finance, which asks finance.post_charge for every line: there is no separate reversal permission (migration 20260916002300, PR #45). No test reverses without the permission

given: an open Folio with a balance and a Staff Member holding finance.manage_folio
when: they close it on the Finance screen
then: it closes with closed_at set, its balance survives (closing is not settling), and folio.closed is recorded with the balance it was closed on; no settled-first rule exists because closure rules are not built
test_name: folios.test.ts: stops anything more being posted to it

given: a closed Folio
when: anybody posts a line — ranza_app or the migration role
then: refused by folio_line_is_postable(), a trigger rather than a policy clause so it binds every role (ADR 0015)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a closed Folio accepts no new lines; nor post to a closed Folio: the trigger binds every role, which a policy does not

given: a closed Folio
when: somebody closes it again
then: refused with FolioWriteError rather than reported as success: only an open Folio matches, and no row returned is read as a refusal (ADR 0015 Consequences)
test_name: folios.test.ts: refuses a second closure rather than reporting success

given: an open Folio
when: its status becomes closed without closed_at, or closed_at is set on an open one
then: refused by folios_closed_at_check: status = closed exactly when closed_at is set (PR #30)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a closed Folio without a closing date is not a state this can reach

given: a Staff Member allowed to close a Folio
when: their update also changes currency, stay_id or property_id
then: refused: the runtime role may update only status, closed_at and updated_at, because row-level security cannot say which columns may change (ADR 0015, ADR 0012 amended)
test_name: folios.test.sql: closing a Folio cannot restate every amount on it by changing the currency; nor move the Folio onto somebody else's Stay; the runtime role may update only a Folio's status, closing date and timestamp

given: one open Folio
when: two Staff Members close it at the same moment
then: one closure and one refusal: the update's predicate status = open is re-evaluated after the first commits (closeFolio docs, PR #30); every closure also takes the Stay's advisory lock (20260916004800). Only sequential closure is tested

given: a charge being posted to an open Folio
when: finance closes the Folio
then: owned by maintenance MT-S5-10 and check-out CO-S1-15: every open-to-closed transition takes the per-Stay advisory lock, so the closure waits and audits a balance that includes the charge

situation: Editing or deleting a posted line
given: a line on any Folio
when: the runtime role updates its amount or description, deletes it, or deletes the Folio
then: refused by three independent statements: no UPDATE/DELETE policy, revoked grants, and folio_lines_append_only (ADR 0015, blueprint 7.4); the line stays as posted
test_name: folios.test.sql: the runtime role cannot rewrite an amount; nor a description; nor remove one; nor the Folio around them

situation: The migration role edits a line
given: the role that runs migrations (superuser locally, BYPASSRLS hosted)
when: it updates or deletes a line
then: refused by the statement-level trigger, which binds every role; the lesson is the audit table that was append-only everywhere except production (ADR 0015)
test_name: folios.test.ts: refuses the migration role too, which no policy binds; folios.test.sql: the migration role cannot rewrite an amount either

given: a superuser
when: they drop folio_lines_append_only and rewrite history
then: not preventable by a constraint; ADR 0015 assigns it to operational controls — restricted access and retained backups

situation: Posting a charge needs its own permission
given: a Staff Member at a billing Property whose role lacks finance.post_charge — the shipped Front desk role
when: they post a charge
then: refused by folio_lines_insert_finance; the shipped Owner, Manager and Finance roles hold finance.post_charge and Front desk does not, because opening a Folio is part of check-in and charging it is not (migration 20260916002300, PR #45). Exercised only through maintenance's chargeGuest, which does not isolate this policy

given: a Staff Member who reaches the Property, whatever their role — Front desk and Housekeeping included
when: they open Finance
then: undecided: which permission reads a Folio and its lines. Today the read policies are reach-based (20260916001200) and the only other gate is the finance capability in the query, so Front desk and Housekeeping see every Folio, line and balance; migrations 20260916003600 and 20260916003900 describe the lines as something the front desk cannot see, which no policy enforces

given: Folios in an Organization the Staff Member has no membership in
when: they list, open, charge or close one
then: nothing is listed, the detail is null, and every write is refused, with the Folio left unchanged (blueprint 3.5, ADR 0012)
test_name: folios.test.ts: shows a Staff Member nothing from a Property in another Organization; hides a Folio from outside, and refuses every write to it

given: a Staff Member of Organization A
when: they open a Folio in B's Property, on B's Stay, or relabel A's Property as B's
then: refused by the insert policy, and unrepresentable by the composite foreign keys even with no policy in the way (PR #30)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a Folio cannot be opened in another Organization's Property; a Folio cannot be opened on another Organization's Stay; and is unrepresentable even with no policy in the way

situation: Out of reach and not there look the same
given: a Folio the viewer cannot reach
when: they open ?folio= for it or post to it
then: null and the list, or a FolioWriteError / refused message, so nothing of it is shown or changed (PR #30 contracts). That the answer is identical to one for a Folio that does not exist is not asserted
test_name: folios.test.ts: hides a Folio from outside, and refuses every write to it

given: reach is unchanged
when: the Subscription is suspended, the Entitlement revoked, or the Property never enabled finance
then: every Folio write is refused, not merely hidden from lists: the write policies name app.can_use_capability (ADR 0012, ADR 0015)
test_name: folios.test.sql: gate 1 denies the write: a suspended Subscription posts nothing; gate 2 denies the write: without the Entitlement there is no billing; gate 3 denies the write: a Property that has not enabled finance holds no Folio

situation: A Resident and their own Folio
given: a Resident with a current Stay that has a Folio
when: they read, post to, open or close a Folio
then: they reach nothing, not even their own Folio: every Folio policy resolves through staff reach and a Portal read will get its own policy (ADR 0009)
test_name: folios.test.sql: a Resident reaches no Folio, not even the one on their own Stay; a Resident cannot post a charge to their own Folio

given: a connection as ranza_app with no acting user
when: it reads or writes Folios
then: nothing is visible and every write is refused (CLAUDE.md: every query on an Organization-owned table goes through withOrganizationContext)
test_name: folios.test.sql: without request context no Folio is visible; without request context no charge can be posted

given: a Finance Staff Member assigned to one of an Organization's Properties
when: they open Finance for another Property
then: nothing is listed, because reach is app.accessible_property_ids(); no Folio test places a Folio at an unassigned Property of the same Organization

given: an open Folio
when: a charge is posted
then: one folio.charge_posted record in the same transaction naming the actor and the Property, with the line, amount and currency (blueprint 7.4, ADR 0031)
test_name: folios.test.ts: writes one line and one audit record naming the actor; folios.test.ts: follows a reversal down, keeping both lines

given: a charge being reversed
when: the reversal commits
then: a folio.line_reversed record carries the reason, the Property, and the amount, currency and description that were taken off (ADR 0031)
test_name: folios.test.ts: follows a reversal down, keeping both lines

situation: Opening a Folio is not its own record
given: a check-in at a billing Property
when: the Folio opens
then: no folio.* record is written for the opening; the check-in's own record is the only one. No ADR says whether opening should be recorded separately

given: a viewer who may use finance at no Property, or a ?property= where it is off
when: they open Finance
then: an empty state saying finance is not on here; an unknown or forged ?property= answers exactly as a switched-off one
test_name: front-desk-property.test.ts: shows nothing when the viewer may use this screen nowhere

given: a billing Property with zero, one or many Folios
when: Finance opens
then: Folios listed open before closed and by unit name, each with Guest (or unit when the Stay had no Reservation), status and balance; empty for a Property nobody has checked into yet
test_name: folios.test.ts: lists the Folios of a Property the viewer reaches, with their balances

given: a Folio opened with ?folio=
when: the panel renders
then: lines newest first in posting order with no sorting or filtering; a reversed charge is struck through and labelled reversed for screen readers; reverse is offered only on an unreversed charge of an open Folio; a closed Folio offers nothing and says so rather than a disabled reopen

given: any post, reverse or close on the screen
when: it does not happen
then: invalid for an amount or reason the viewer can fix; one refused message for everything else — closed, out of reach, already reversed, not there

given: the Finance destination
when: it is reached through the rail in tr, en or ar
then: the page is in that language
test_name: locale.spec.ts: a page reached through the rail on /<locale> is in that language

given: a Folio in JPY, TRY or KWD viewed in tr, en or ar
when: an amount is shown
then: money is formatted by Intl in the viewer's locale with the minor-unit exponent read for the currency at display and nowhere else, after every sum (ADR 0015); ar mirrors right to left through logical utilities and times are 24-hour. Checked by hand in PR #30; formatMoney and the mirrored panel have no automated test

situation: The typed amount is scaled by a currency the form sends
given: the charge form carries the Folio's currency as a hidden input and server/finance.ts reads it from the form
when: a caller submits currency=KWD, or JPY, for a TRY Folio
then: 12.5 becomes 12500 kuruş, or 12.5 is refused and 125 posts as 1.25 lira: the amount's scale follows a value the caller supplies. server/finance.ts:74-78 says the currency comes from the Folio the server rendered and then reads it from the form; the exponent should come from the Folio's stored currency, applied by the module. It grants no new power — a holder of finance.post_charge can post any amount — but it breaks the invariant the code states

situation: The shipped Front desk role closes any Folio
given: the shipped front_desk role holds finance.manage_folio (20260916002300, never removed)
when: a Front desk Staff Member closes an in-house Guest's Folio carrying money, or reopens a closed one
then: it succeeds: front_desk_closes_only_a_settled_folio exempts holders of finance.manage_folio. ADR 0030 says a front-desk role may close only a settled Folio of an ended Stay and everything else is finance.manage_folio's; the test uses a custom check-out-only role, not the shipped one

given: a Guest pays at the desk
when: the payment is recorded
then: deferred: there is no payment line type (ADR 0015, PR #30, roadmap Folio foundation); check-out's PRE-01 is waiting on it

given: a card or transfer
when: money is processed
then: deferred: external payment processing is a separately entitled integration (blueprint 5.9); recording money is not moving it, so there is no gateway, provider or pending state (ADR 0015)

situation: Taxes, discounts, deposits, credits and refunds
given: a charge carrying tax or a discount, or value held for or returned to a Guest
when: it is recorded
then: deferred: blueprint 5.9, not built (ADR 0015, roadmap Folio foundation); a rounding or tax policy is when the module gains a domain layer (folios README); refund approval is also deferred by check-out CO-S2-13

given: part of a charge was wrong
when: it is corrected
then: deferred: that is an adjustment, a separate blueprint 5.9 workflow; today only a full reversal exists (ADR 0015)

given: one Stay billed to two accounts, or a company paying
when: charges are routed
then: deferred: one Folio per Stay by unique index; split folios, charge routing and company billing are blueprint 5.9 and not built (roadmap)

given: a Folio that must be settled or approved before closing, or reopened afterwards
when: it is closed or reopened
then: deferred: folio closure rules are blueprint 5.9 and not built (ADR 0015, folios README); finance may close with a balance, and no command or button reopens a Folio, although the update policy does not refuse closed to open for finance.manage_folio

given: an in-house Stay
when: a business date arrives
then: deferred: room-night posting will be a worker job through the outbox, and a job-posted charge will carry a source key the database makes unique (ADR 0020, ADR 0017); nothing posts room nights yet

given: a charge posted at 02:00
when: its period is decided
then: deferred: posted_at stays a timestamptz, and a line gains a business date when it gains a reason to (ADR 0021)

given: a closed Folio
when: an invoice or e-archive document is issued
then: deferred: e-invoice, e-archive and fiscal numbering belong to the Türkiye regional pack (blueprint 10.1) and are not in the roadmap's built work

given: a closed business day
when: Folio postings reach Accounting
then: deferred: Accounting is blueprint 5.10; postings will travel through packages/adapters, since platform modules may not name a Folio (ADR 0015, blueprint 9.8)

given: a Resident in the Portal
when: they open their Folio
then: deferred: balance and folio viewing is a Portal capability (blueprint 4.3) that will get its own policy through app.resident_stay_property_ids(), never a widening of the Staff ones (ADR 0009, folios README)
